WORKING:
- Speech bubbles show server-computed summaries (MCP tools show action: 'Browser: screenshot', files show just name: 'Editing store.ts')
- Worker panel shows task extracted from JSONL (first user message, cleaned), current focus, recent tools list
- Clickable worker panel: expand to see full task, last 5 tools, Focus Terminal button
- Planning room: EnterPlanMode/ExitPlanMode detected in pre-tool-use → workers walk to meeting room spots (cols 14-17, rows 9-11)
- UserPromptSubmit hook fires on every user prompt → POSTs to /api/hooks/user-prompt → quick fallback title extracted immediately
- PIXEL_OFFICE_HAIKU env guard prevents recursion when spawning claude calls

BROKEN:
- LLM title refinement via claude -p: ~70s due to hook timeouts, too slow for real use
- No good source for 'what the worker is actually focused on right now'

NEXT:
- Debug non-pixel-office hook timeouts (memory/curation hooks hitting offline services)
- Once claude -p is fast: haiku gets last 4 user messages from JSONL + current task → 3-8 word focus title
